QUESTION ONE: Prose

Refer to Text A, "Elliot", on page 2 of the resource booklet.

Analyse how the writer shows us the developing friendship between the narrator and Elliot.

Support your answer with evidence from the text.
questions.markingGuide: Achievement (3-4): Engage with the text by addressing the question, exploring a relevant idea using analysis-related terminology. Show awareness that meaning has been deliberately crafted. Include specific details from the text. Merit (5-6): Convincingly address the question, presenting a reasoned discussion of one or more ideas. Show awareness of deliberate crafting for a particular purpose. Weave a range of specific details. Excellence (7-8): Develop an insightful or original argument or interpretation. Make judgments about how effects and meanings relate to the purpose of the text. Ideas might include: how first impressions can be superficial; how unlikely friendships can result from being thrust together; how friendships can grow from appreciating each other's interests, trying new things together, and looking out for each other.
